Yes, this matches what I wanted. Setting how many show at once to 48, the default order to Title A–Z, and the text size to Large updated the preview right away, and the card reads comfortably at the bigger size. I like that these just become my defaults — and the note that individual views can still be temporarily reordered means I'm not locked in; if I want newest-first for one particular look, I can still do that in the moment without changing my overall preference. And it's clear this only changes how things look and the default order, not the actual bookmarks themselves. That's exactly right.

That covers everything I was hoping to manage. With saving, editing, labels, the full search, read-later and finished, duplicates, delete, archive, the error recoveries, big-collection handling, import, export, sorting, bulk actions, saved searches, and now these preferences all settled, I'm happy with the full picture we've explored.
